{"aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":11,"markdown":"### jt-vc-portal Meeting Portal Audit｜jt-vc-portal 會議入口稽核

`jt-vc-portal` · rules 132100-132199｜規則 132100-132199

jt-vc-portal（JaaS／Jitsi 會議入口）稽核記錄、docker 事件與檔案完整性中的：來自公開位址、管理員與新位址的登入、在其他位址使用的工作階段、暴力破解、密碼噴灑與撞庫、帳號與單一登入變更、安全事件外拋、設定匯出、大量下載與刪除錄影、在容器內執行的緊急指令，以及簽署金鑰。

Sign-ins from public addresses, administrators and new addresses, sessions used from another address, brute force, spraying and stuffing, account and single sign-on changes, the security event export, settings exports, bulk downloads and deletions of recordings, the portal's emergency commands in its container and its signing key, from the jt-vc-portal audit log (JaaS / Jitsi meeting portal), docker events and file integrity.
